title: SREV-039 api copy string to user

audit_contract.description: API: Api_CopyStringToUser | data: {"input": "driver-owned WCHAR string plus byte length including trailing NUL", "output": "user UNICODE_STRING64 buffer and updated Length"} | callers: Api_GetHomePath, Process_Api_QueryProcessInfo, Process_Api_QueryInfo, Process_Api_QueryBoxPath, Conf_Api_Query

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: len is a byte count and must be aligned to sizeof(WCHAR)
nonzero len must be at least sizeof(WCHAR) and requires a non-NULL source string
UNICODE_STRING64.MaximumLength is a byte count and must be aligned to sizeof(WCHAR)
nonzero len requires a non-NULL user Buffer
len must be <= MaximumLength before writing to Buffer
UNICODE_STRING64.Length is set to len - sizeof(WCHAR) because the copied trailing NUL is not counted
